status: Writer arithmetic only; independent legal and whole-pack review pending

cases.name: Private employer ordinary social base
cases.assumptions: Employer and every payment are documented as ordinary private-sector/in-scope; this is social insurance only, not net pay.

cases.name: Public institution ordinary social base
cases.assumptions: Institution meets the actual public category and is not a higher-education or medical exception.

cases.name: Civil aviation listed private role
cases.assumptions: Actual private civil-aviation role is on the statutory special-condition list; ordinary hazardous work alone does not establish this tariff.

cases.name: Civil aviation listed public role
cases.assumptions: Actual public civil-aviation role is within the specified list.

cases.name: Agricultural employer and state shares
cases.assumptions: Documented qualifying agricultural activity and annual/policy gates satisfied; no automatic grant from a bank label.

cases.name: Fixed founder full calendar year
cases.assumptions: Registered throughout 2026; no pension/disability/insured-employment/suspension or sickness exception.

cases.name: Justice professional full calendar year
cases.assumptions: Qualifying justice profession; no exemption, suspension or sickness period.

cases.name: Patent two touched calendar months
cases.assumptions: A 2026 patent touches two calendar months, even if each is partial; no exemption.

cases.name: Taxi June hiring remaining days
cases.assumptions: A June 2026 qualifying taxi-driver hiring covers ten remaining calendar days out of thirty; no claim to the July ordinary regime.

cases.name: Day worker contribution arithmetic
cases.assumptions: Day worker covered by the statutory category, no competing-insurance exemption; pay is above the stated full-day minimum. This is not ordinary employee SSC.

cases.name: IT park insured income and budget allocation
cases.assumptions: Qualifying employment at one IT-park employer; single-tax paid is an evidenced assumption, not computed here. Civil contracts require their separate treatment.

cases.name: Independent services annual band arithmetic
cases.assumptions: Documented new independent service-entrepreneur category for a full 2026 year. Cumulative annual reconciliation only; monthly notices and any health top-up are separate.

cases.name: Voluntary agriculture final-month adjustment
cases.assumptions: Individual unregistered agricultural landholder/tenant voluntarily insured for full year under the actual category; preserve CNAS published monthly adjustment.

cases.name: Social arrears simple daily charge
cases.assumptions: Constant actual social principal debt and ten chargeable days, ordinary category; no agricultural deferral, debt movements or statutory exception. CNAS actual account governs application.
